title: Surface area of polynomial threshold sets
statement: Let $n,k\ge0$, and let $p$ be a real polynomial in $n$ variables whose total degree is at most $k$. The Gaussian surface area of the set $\{x\in\mathbb R^n:p(x)\ge0\}$ is at most $k/\sqrt{2\pi}$.
hypotheses_covered: The polynomial has real coefficients and $n$ variables
The polynomial's total degree is at most $k
